event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event, used for idempotency and threading.

thread_id.description: Groups events belonging to one orchestration run.

in_reply_to.description: event_id this event responds to, if any.

relayed_by.description: Human-relay agents that touched this event en route, in order. Present for auditability when a message crosses more than one relay hop.

agent_id.description: Stable label for this agent within the run, e.g. 'planner', 'implementer', 'reviewer-human'.

regime.description: Derived from 'surface' via the lookup table in the surface-regimes skill. Not set independently of surface; present here so a receiving agent without that skill loaded still sees the regime stated explicitly.

active_skills.description: Skill names active by default for this surface, per the surface-regimes skill's activation table. Also derived, not hand-set. A mismatch between this field and a receiving agent's own inference is worth surfacing rather than silently resolving.
